text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even on the day of the race, the Trainer 
cannot dispel their anxiety. In truth, 
they want to stand beside Symboli Kris S 
as an unshakeable equal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S tells her Trainer 
that there is no need to hide their 
anxiety. At their core, they share the 
common bond of making someone else's wish 
their own.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Beyond that, it was crucial that she and 
her Trainer were different. Proposing 
their respective opinions and combining 
their strengths was what brought them this 
far.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the paddock, Symboli Kris S senses a 
prickling, alien aura radiating from 
Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Symboli Kris S remained 
unshakeable. —And now, the grand stage to 
determine the pinnacle began.
